I addressed all six requested changes from the review on head `4739a4a6bf0b355575ed0c1abc6c216eb458355c`.

1. **Before/after UI screenshots (`crates/ui/`)**:
   I captured `1440x960` software-WGPU screenshots from `ShellUi` on `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`) and on this branch.
   I uploaded the four PNGs to `mkinney/Camcraft` `pr-screenshots` (`0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86`) and linked them in the PR body.
   No image or capture code is on this PR branch.
   `tests/tool_undercut.rs::slot_undercut_page_shows_its_geometry_heights_passes_and_feeds_fields` and `dovetail_properties_and_editor_edit_flank_angle_without_corner_radius` open the Slot Undercut page and tool editor.

2. **Dovetail flank angle, undercut defaults, and corner-radius filter (`crates/ui/`)**:
   I added `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_undercut_row.rs` (`seed` and `dovetail_row`) and wired it in `tool_settings.rs`.
   `seed` sets sane defaults and zero `corner_r` when switching to kinds `18..=21` (`TSlot`, `Keyseat`, `Dovetail`, `Lollipop`).
   `dovetail_row` renders `Flank angle (deg)` for `ToolKind::Dovetail`, and `tool_cutter_params.rs` renders `flank angle °`.
   `tool_settings.rs` hides `Corner radius` for all four undercut kinds.
   Pinned by: `tool_undercut_row::tests` (2 unit tests), `tool_undercut::new_tool_undercut_kinds_seed_sane_defaults_hide_corner_radius_and_show_dovetail_flank_angle`, `tool_undercut::dovetail_properties_and_editor_edit_flank_angle_without_corner_radius`, and `tool_cutter_params::each_milling_kind_shows_the_parameters_its_outline_is_drawn_from`.

3. **Keep neighbouring parts on part-source `SlotUndercut` (`crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs`)**:
   I added `OpParams::SlotUndercut(_)` to `is_part_kept_kind` so `neighbour_parts` and `kept_rejudge` check other setup parts.
   Pinned by: `tests/mcp_slot_undercut.rs::a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts`.

4. **Preserve `0.0` `bulge` and `neck_slot` keys in JSON (`crates/app/src/project/undercut_dto.rs`)**:
   I removed `skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` from `bulge` and `neck_slot` and removed `is_zero` while keeping `#[serde(default)]`.
   `list_operation_types` now exposes both fields, and `edit_operation` accepts `0.0` updates.
   Pinned by: `tests/mcp_slot_undercut.rs::list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot`.

5. **Support undercut moves in Simulate playback (`crates/app/src/stock_play.rs`, `stock_play_head.rs`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/partial.rs`)**:
   I added `Stock::with_partial_undercut` via a shared `partial_cut_with` helper in `partial.rs`.
   I updated `PlayOp`, `PlayIndex::of`, `FieldPlay::from_seed`, `FieldPlay::cut`, and `FieldPlay::set_partial` to simulate `Planned::undercut`.
   Pinned by: `tests/stock_play.rs::playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view` and `tests/stock_play_partial.rs::partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy`.

6. **Merge `upstream/main` conflict (`crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/cut_twin_work.rs`)**:
   I merged `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`) and kept both `tilt_basis::CURRENT_TILT_BASIS` and `undercut::SlotUndercutOp`.
   I also handled `SdfTool::Dovetail` in `cut_twin_work::twin_tool` from upstream #2741.

**Gate and checks on `4739a4a6bf0b355575ed0c1abc6c216eb458355c`**:
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed (0 warnings).
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 735 steps run; 733 passed and 2 failed. Both failures fail on `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`): `feature_edge_g1_join::no_pickable_edge_is_a_tangent_piece_of_a_longer_one_in_any_step_fixture` (#2713 on `bar_cross_holes.step`), and three `fig8` tests in `tests/shoulder_adaptive.rs`.

The PR remains a draft as before. Please re-review head `4739a4a6bf0b355575ed0c1abc6c216eb458355c`.

Needs changes before merge.

## What looks good

- The six findings from the earlier head are addressed. The screenshot links load and show both views before and after the change.
- The dovetail angle controls, valid cutter defaults, and corner-radius filter have passing UI tests.
- The MCP tests pass for neighbouring parts and zero-valued `bulge` and `neck_slot` fields.
- Both playback suites pass with the undercut head and neck.
- The trial merge with current main is clean.
- I checked all four new CL goldens line by line. Entry, exit, pass offsets, feeds, arc centres, and Z changes agree with the generator parameters. No existing golden moved.

## Results merged with main

I tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2714`. The PR head is `4739a4a6bf0b355575ed0c1abc6c216eb458355c`. The main commit is `971c23faa026865be47e425a660439f8c3d17ecd`. The local trial merge is `abfe7a9f406d4fa0ee4dd5349205cf4b63d50e98`.

No runner ran. No review evidence was added to the PR branch.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 720 steps completed with no failed step. The run then became VOID before UI execution. A relative build-directory setting created the untracked `crates/ui/target/` directory. HEAD and tracked source files did not change. This run has no overall gate verdict.
- I ran the remaining UI plan with an absolute build directory: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ui --only clippy`. It selected 18 UI steps. Seventeen passed. The UI unit suite failed four tests. The quick plan contains no clippy step.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with zero warnings.
- The first cache attempt failed because the sccache server could not write its preprocessor directory. The retries used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=''`. An interrupted launcher also left a child gate running. Both gate children finished before the mutations started.

The two failures from the author's earlier gate did not recur in the app suites on this trial merge.

## Safety mutations

I repeated two safety mutations from the earlier review. Each mutation changed only the local review worktree. Each source file was restored.

1. Disable the Z-move conviction in `crates/sim/src/verify/undercut.rs`. `a_dive_into_uncut_stock_is_refused` and `a_retract_inside_the_undercut_is_refused` failed. Result: 12 passed, 2 failed. Restore the check: 14 passed, 0 failed.
2. Replace the neck radius with the head radius in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_undercut.rs`. `the_field_removes_the_undercut_and_keeps_the_roof` and `the_field_cuts_a_lollipop_groove_round` failed. Result: 12 passed, 2 failed. Restore the radius: 14 passed, 0 failed.

## Extra suites run

- All app reader suites listed below ran in the quick gate and passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --lib --tests`: 95 test targets passed; 798 tests passed. This includes the post preview unit tests and all post integration readers.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-cl --test headless_bin`: 3 passed. This includes `cl_text_round_trips_every_golden`.
- The PR changes no STEP fixture, importer, or kernel source. The importer rule does not select extra kernel suites.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/app/tests/golden_undercut.rs:7`: move this generator-only suite and its goldens to `camcraft-motion`. Its imports at lines 15–19 are motion, CL, geometry, and tool re-exports. The suite tests no app command, project file, operation, MCP tool, or CLI. The writer in `tests/common` does not change what the suite tests. Current upstream AGENTS.md requires each new test file to live in the lowest crate that provides its imports. Update its Gate map to name that crate. Keep the app MCP and playback tests here.

2. `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md:84`: complete the literature search required by #1444 and record the checked sources. The decision and PR body state that no search ran. The issue explicitly requires this step for undercut paths and non-convex simulation. A list recalled from memory does not complete that step. Cite the material that supports the entry, exit, profile, and simulation choices. Record any limitations that the search finds.

3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/frame_cost_probe.rs:278`: obtain a passing result for the four area-preview tests before merge. The UI gate fails at the shared `adaptive_preview` precondition. A rerun with one test thread gives the same four failures. Open issue [#2766](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/2766) describes this fig8 defect. This is a known gate failure, not evidence that the undercut change caused it. Use the main fix for #2766 when available, then rerun these tests and the UI gate.

The four failing tests are:

- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_caches::pick_chips_group_the_welded_faces_once_and_follow_the_picks`
- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_caches::pick_lines_build_once_per_input`
- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_probe::area_preview_fill_is_made_once_per_draft`
- `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_probe::still_frames_on_fig8_name_their_costs`

Exact shared failure:

```text
panicked at crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/frame_cost_probe.rs:278:5:
the area preview is filled
```

The focused rerun passed one other frame-cost test and failed these four tests.

## Notes

The PR remains mergeable and in draft. The review label remains `needs-rework`. The earlier screenshot, tool-editor, kept-part, JSON, playback, and merge-conflict findings are resolved on this head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the three findings from the latest review on `4739a4a6bf0b355575ed0c1abc6c216eb458355c`.

1. Moved the generator suite and four unchanged CL files to `crates/motion/tests/`. Updated its imports and Gate map. `camcraft-motion --test golden_undercut` passes all four tests. Removing the motion target gives RED. Changing feed from 120 to 121 gives four failures. Restoring it gives GREEN.
2. Completed the literature search with the web tool. Perplexity was unavailable. `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md` records checked sources for entry, exit, profiles, and simulation. It states their limits and the search timing. The temporary content audit gives RED on the old decision (0/8) and GREEN on the updated decision (8/8). Updated the stale PR body text.
3. Merged `upstream/main` at `e5b0ca3c1`, including the preview fix from #2767. Issue #2766 remains open for the separate default-containment defect.
